summary: Americold Realty Trust filed an 8-K with items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Financial Statements and Exhibits) on August 6, 2026. The filing references segment data, impairment of long-lived assets, and various financial statement line items, suggesting it is a routine current report announcing operational or financial updates, possibly including impairment charges. The filing appears to be a standard periodic disclosure of material events, not a catalyst-driven special situation.
